name: Farmers Market Stall
role: You are a friendly local farmer.
speaker: Farmer

tasks.goal: Greet the farmer and state your purpose
tasks.hint: State your main purpose clearly upon arrival.
tasks.done_when: Learner greeted the farmer and stated purpose.

tasks.goal: Inquire about today's fresh organic produce selection
tasks.hint: Ask what crops were harvested today.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about fresh produce selection.

tasks.goal: Ask where the farm is located and local growing practices
tasks.hint: Inquire about farm origin and organic methods.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about farm location and growing methods.

tasks.goal: Request a sample slice of fresh heirloom apples
tasks.hint: Ask if tasting produce is allowed before buying.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked to sample fruit produce.
tasks.scene_hint: Crates of ripe strawberries and fresh herbs line wooden table displays.

tasks.goal: Ask for ripe avocados suitable for eating today
tasks.hint: Inquire which produce is ready to consume immediately.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for ripe produce ready for immediate consumption.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'organic'
tasks.hint: Organic means grown without synthetic chemicals. Ask if vegetables are organic.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'organic'.

tasks.goal: Ask for storage tips to keep fresh greens crisp longer
tasks.hint: Inquire how to preserve vegetables at home.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for produce storage advice.

tasks.goal: Negotiate a bundle price discount for buying a full bushel
tasks.hint: Ask for bulk pricing when purchasing multiple items.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated bulk produce discount.

tasks.goal: Inquire about seasonal availability of wild mushrooms
tasks.hint: Ask when specific seasonal items arrive.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about seasonal mushroom availability.

tasks.goal: Politely report a bruised peach in the bag and ask for swap
tasks.hint: Ask vendor to exchange a damaged piece of fruit.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked to swap damaged produce.
tasks.scene_hint: Chalkboard signs list crop prices under colorful market canopy tents.

tasks.goal: Ask if produce is washed before display
tasks.hint: Inquire if vegetables need rinsing at home.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about produce washing and food safety.

tasks.goal: Confirm total price for produce weighed on scale
tasks.hint: Ask for final cost of weighed items.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed total produce price.

tasks.goal: Inquire if digital mobile pay or cash only is accepted
tasks.hint: Ask how payment is processed at the stall.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about payment options at market stall.

tasks.goal: Request sturdy paper bags for carrying heavy root vegetables
tasks.hint: Ask vendor for double bags for heavy items.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested extra paper bags.

tasks.goal: Thank the farmer and bid farewell
tasks.hint: Express gratitude and close the conversation.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked the farmer AND said goodbye.

tasks.goal: Inquire about seasonal fruit availability at the market stall today
tasks.hint: Ask vendor what fresh fruits arrived from farm harvest.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about seasonal fruit availability.

tasks.goal: Express preference for locally grown heirloom vegetable varieties
tasks.hint: State enthusiasm for supporting regional family farms.
tasks.done_when: Learner expressed preference for local heirloom vegetables.

tasks.goal: Ask vendor how long they have operated their market stall
tasks.hint: Inquire about farm history and market participation.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked vendor about market stall history.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'pesticide'
tasks.hint: Pesticide refers to chemicals used on crops. Inquire if produce is grown without synthetic pesticides.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'pesticide'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'artisanal'
tasks.hint: Artisanal refers to handcrafted food production. Ask about the artisan cheese or honey selection.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'artisanal'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'harvest'
tasks.hint: Harvest refers to gathering mature crops. Ask when the current crop was harvested.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'harvest'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'cultivation'
tasks.hint: Cultivation is the act of growing crops. Inquire about soil health and cultivation methods used on the farm.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'cultivation'.

tasks.goal: Discuss crop rotation methods used to maintain soil health on the farm
tasks.hint: Inquire about regenerative agriculture practices.
tasks.done_when: Learner discussed soil health crop rotation methods.

tasks.goal: Ask vendor how heirloom tomato seeds are preserved across seasons
tasks.hint: Inquire about seed saving traditions and open-pollinated crops.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about heirloom seed preservation.

tasks.goal: Discuss cold storage transport techniques for preserving berry freshness
tasks.hint: Inquire how delicate fruits travel from farm to market.
tasks.done_when: Learner discussed berry transport cold storage techniques.

tasks.goal: Inquire about community supported agriculture CSA weekly subscription boxes
tasks.hint: Ask vendor how to sign up for seasonal harvest deliveries.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about CSA subscription box options.

tasks.goal: Discuss microclimate factors affecting early spring asparagus yield
tasks.hint: Inquire how frost protection affects early crop harvests.
tasks.done_when: Learner discussed microclimate impact on crop yields.

tasks.goal: Ask vendor about natural pest management using beneficial insects
tasks.hint: Inquire about ladybugs and predatory mites instead of sprays.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about natural insect pest management.

tasks.goal: Discuss pasteurization and aging processes for farmstead raw goat cheese
tasks.hint: Inquire about cheese wheel aging times and rind development.
tasks.done_when: Learner discussed farmstead cheese aging processes.

tasks.goal: Inquire about raw unpasteurized honey pollen sources and filtration
tasks.hint: Ask vendor if honey comes from wildflowers or orchard blossoms.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about honey pollen sources and filtration.

tasks.goal: Discuss preserving methods for canning seasonal fruit jams and pickles
tasks.hint: Inquire about pectin levels and glass jar hot water bath processing.
tasks.done_when: Learner discussed fruit canning and pickle preservation.

tasks.goal: Ask vendor about wholesale pricing for bulk purchasing canning tomatoes
tasks.hint: Negotiate volume pricing for fifty-pound produce crates.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated wholesale bulk produce pricing.

tasks.goal: Ask vendor if sample slices of fresh melon are available to taste
tasks.hint: Request tasting fruit slice before buying whole melon.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked to taste fresh melon sample.
tasks.scene_hint: A wooden cutting board holds sliced cantaloupe beside a bowl of toothpicks.

tasks.goal: Inquire where canvas tote bags are displayed for carrying produce
tasks.hint: Ask vendor if reusable cotton market bags are for sale.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about reusable canvas tote bags.
tasks.scene_hint: Heavy canvas tote bags featuring farm logos hang from tent support poles.

tasks.goal: Ask vendor to weigh a mesh bag of red potatoes on the counter scale
tasks.hint: Request price calculation based on exact weight.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked vendor to weigh potatoes on scale.
tasks.scene_hint: Brass scale dial swings steadily as red potatoes rest in the hanging tray.

tasks.goal: Inquire if wooden crates on display can be purchased for home storage
tasks.hint: Ask vendor if rustic wooden boxes are available.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about buying wooden produce crates.
tasks.scene_hint: Weathered wooden fruit crates stacked three high display fresh crisp apples.

tasks.goal: Ask vendor to bundle a fresh bunch of basil with a rubber band
tasks.hint: Request securing loose herb stems for transport.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested bundling fresh herb stems.
tasks.scene_hint: Aroma of crushed basil and mint leaves wafts from wet wicker baskets.

tasks.goal: Inquire about hand washing station locations near public market rest areas
tasks.hint: Ask where customers can rinse fresh fruit before eating.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about public market hand washing stations.
tasks.scene_hint: A portable sink station with foot pumps stands near colorful food stalls.

tasks.goal: Ask vendor if chalkboard price signs reflect weekly special discounts
tasks.hint: Inquire about marked down produce items.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about chalkboard sign discount prices.
tasks.scene_hint: Chalk dust traces handwritten prices on black wooden boards above crop bins.

tasks.goal: Inquire if cold ice packs are provided for transporting fresh cheese
tasks.hint: Ask vendor how to keep dairy chilled during warm afternoon walk.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about ice packs for perishable cheese.
tasks.scene_hint: Condensation beads glisten on glass-fronted cooler boxes holding cheese wheels.

tasks.goal: Ask vendor to trim long leafy greens from fresh orange carrots
tasks.hint: Request cutting off carrot tops to fit in tote bag.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested trimming carrot greens.
tasks.scene_hint: Shears snip crisp green carrot tops over a wooden scrap barrel.

tasks.goal: Inquire about rain canopy coverage during unexpected afternoon showers
tasks.hint: Ask vendor if goods remain protected under tent awnings.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about market tent rain protection.
tasks.scene_hint: Raindrops patter softly against blue canvas canopy awnings overhead.

tasks.goal: Ask vendor if farm tour open house days are scheduled this autumn
tasks.hint: Inquire about visiting farm fields during harvest season.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about public farm tour dates.
tasks.scene_hint: Flyers printed on kraft paper advertise autumn pumpkin patch visits.

tasks.goal: Respond when vendor recommends trying a newly harvested apple variety
tasks.hint: Agree to purchase two pounds of the recommended apples.
tasks.done_when: Learner agreed to try recommended apple variety.

tasks.goal: Clarify total bill amount when vendor miscounts produce items
tasks.hint: Politely recount items in bag to verify accurate price.
tasks.done_when: Learner clarified total produce bill amount.

tasks.goal: Address vendor comment that peaches are extremely ripe and soft
tasks.hint: Request firmer peaches suitable for storing a few days.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested firmer produce for storage.

tasks.goal: Politely decline vendor offer to add extra herbs to purchase bag
tasks.hint: State that current herb quantity is sufficient for recipe.
tasks.done_when: Learner declined additional herb offer.

tasks.goal: Respond to vendor inquiry about intended recipe for root vegetables
tasks.hint: Mention plans for making roasted vegetable soup.
tasks.done_when: Learner shared intended cooking recipe with vendor.

tasks.goal: Address situation where vendor runs low on small bill change
tasks.hint: Offer exact change or pay with digital contactless card.
tasks.done_when: Learner offered exact cash change to vendor.

tasks.goal: Clarify produce origin when vendor mentions neighboring farm sourcing
tasks.hint: Verify which items were grown directly on vendor's land.
tasks.done_when: Learner clarified farm produce sourcing origin.

tasks.goal: Respond when vendor points out special discount on bruised cooking apples
tasks.hint: Select four cooking apples for pie baking.
tasks.done_when: Learner selected discounted cooking apples.

tasks.goal: Address vendor request to hold produce bag while selecting additional items
tasks.hint: Set bag on counter while picking out fresh garlic heads.
tasks.done_when: Learner set bag on counter while selecting items.

tasks.goal: Clarify storage instructions after vendor explains micro-greens care
tasks.hint: Confirm whether greens should be stored in airtight containers.
tasks.done_when: Learner clarified micro-greens storage instructions.

tasks.goal: Respond to vendor notice that wild mushrooms were gathered yesterday morning
tasks.hint: Select a portion of wild chanterelles for dinner.
tasks.done_when: Learner selected wild mushrooms after freshness notice.

tasks.goal: Address vendor suggestion to pair artisan goat cheese with fresh fig jam
tasks.hint: Add jar of fig jam to produce order.
tasks.done_when: Learner accepted cheese and jam pairing suggestion.

tasks.goal: Clarify cash receipt total when vendor hands over change
tasks.hint: Double check change returned against bill total.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified change returned by vendor.

tasks.goal: Confirm market closing hours before browsing neighboring vendor stalls
tasks.hint: Ask vendor when market stalls pack up for the day.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed market closing hours.

tasks.goal: Ask vendor if pre-ordered produce boxes can be held until afternoon pickup
tasks.hint: Inquire about holding paid purchases at stall.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about holding pre-ordered produce.

tasks.goal: Inquire about organic certification seals displayed on farm banner
tasks.hint: Ask vendor which agency inspects farm crops.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about organic certification inspecting bodies.

tasks.goal: Request vendor to pack delicate heirloom tomatoes on top of heavy squash
tasks.hint: Ask vendor to arrange produce carefully in paper bag.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested delicate produce placed on top.

tasks.goal: Ask vendor if dried lavender bundles are available for purchase
tasks.hint: Inquire about aromatic dried floral products.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about dried lavender bundle availability.

tasks.goal: Confirm whether customer loyalty stamp cards are offered at market
tasks.hint: Ask vendor if repeat visits earn product discounts.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed market loyalty stamp card program.

tasks.goal: Inquire about seasonal cider pressing demonstrations scheduled at market
tasks.hint: Ask vendor when apple cider making takes place.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about cider pressing demonstration times.

tasks.goal: Inquire about winter indoor market location when outdoor season ends
tasks.hint: Ask vendor where stall moves during cold winter months.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about winter indoor market location.

tasks.goal: Ask vendor for farm website address to order holiday gift baskets
tasks.hint: Inquire where online produce ordering details are published.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for farm website address for gift baskets.

tasks.goal: Confirm payment receipt total including state sales tax details
tasks.hint: Verify printed cash receipt breakdown.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed payment receipt tax breakdown.

tasks.goal: Request vendor contact info for placing advance catering orders
tasks.hint: Ask for phone number to reserve large produce quantities.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested vendor contact info for catering.

tasks.goal: Ask vendor where to return empty glass milk bottles for deposit refund
tasks.hint: Inquire about glass container recycling deposit returns.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked where to return glass milk bottles.

tasks.goal: Express appreciation to vendor for fresh quality produce and advice
tasks.hint: Thank vendor for friendly market stall service.
tasks.done_when: Learner expressed gratitude for vendor produce quality.

name_translations.Japanese: ファーマーズマーケットスタンド

place_translations.Japanese: 室外の新鮮な野菜市場
